# Expected changes for Patch 50: Atlantic City - America's Playground / Season 16 on March 26, 2024

![Expected changes for Patch 50: Atlantic City - America's Playground / Season 16 on March 26, 2024](/uploads/309_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The next Fallout 76 update called “Atlantic City - America`s Playground” (Patch 50) awaits us on March 26th, 2024**. As with every content update, the current season 15 ends and the new season 16 begins. On the PTS we have already been able to test or examine numerous changes and new upcoming rewards. Here you will find a summary of the expected changes. As always with PTS content, there can of course be deviations.

## New Expedition: The Human Condition

In the new Atlantic City Expedition "The Human Condition" you travel to the new Flooded City Center and help the Muni faction and Mayor Tim fight against the Overgrowns, find supplies, activate terminals, etc. The final battle also takes place against Overgrowns, not against the Jersey Devil as was often assumed.

**Youtube video of the expedition "The Human Condition":**
![PTS: Atlantic City Expedition The Human Condition](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pts-ac-the-human-condition-beta-youtube.jpg)

*Note: The PITT expedition "Poke the Beehive" was not playable on the PTS and was previously only visible in the game files. So probably won't be released with Patch 50.*

## Free exploration of Atlantic City

In addition to the new and old expeditions, you now also have the opportunity to simply visit the area and explore freely, regardless of an expedition. This is also required in some of the new quests.

![Atlantic City: Travel to District](/uploads/nukaknights-pts-ac-travel-20240128105455-1.jpg)

## 4 new main quests

The 4 new main quests take you to Atlantic City and involve you in the mafia's machinations in connection with the drug "Devils Blood", which is obtained from the blood of the "Jersey Devil" and his offspring. You will visit places in Appalachia as well as in Atlantic City (without an expedition).

As a reward for these quests you will receive the new blueprints for the new "Civil Engineer Armor" (formerly known as "Muni Armor"). The plans are spread across all quests.

These main quests await you:

- **Opportunities** (EN: Opportunity Knocking)
- **The whole world is a stage** (EN: The world is a stage)
- **A Question of Honor** (EN: Honor Bound)
- **The Sins of the Father** (EN: Sins of the Father)
 In this quest you will meet the **Jersey Devil** in the finale

To activate the first main quest, you can read the new "Nightclub Advertising Poster" at every train station.

If you are curious about the new quests or if you get stuck in a quest later, you can find the complete quests here:
